reviews.title: What a Find!
reviews.body: I ordered this product for my husband and I am Amazed at how great it works for him! He has tried many products that you put the time & money into just to have it not work. So I am so Thankful for him and I when he does not get a Good nights sleep I do not get a good nights sleep. Now we both sleep Great!
reviews.name: Michelle R.

reviews.title: It Works!
reviews.body: I am 77 and have had sleeping issues for years. Some nights I get no sleep but I'm fortunate that it does not affect my energy level the next day but getting a full night's sleep is wonderful (at least from what I remember). I am being treated for sleep apnea, insomnia, and restless legs and I take a milligram of alprazolam every night. Some nights it just doesn't work. I saw SleepFuel advertised on Facebook and thought it was worth a try and I'm glad I took the plunge. I'll admit some nights it doesn't do much more than the medication does but that's just the way it is. However, most nights I don't even remember turning out the light; it works that fast for me. I don't necessarily stay asleep all night but I get more hours in than before. Last night was the first time I tried using it when I woke up at 2:00 or so, and I did get more sleep after that. I don't think I'll ever get as much or as deep a sleep as I did when I was younger, but this has improved my sleep immensely. I recommend.
reviews.name: Phyllis H.

reviews.title: Sleep fuel review
reviews.body: I’ve been using SleepFuel drink mix for the last month and have found that it helps me sleep through the night. I normally can fall asleep when I first go to bed, but I often wake up later in the night and cannot fall back to sleep. I am so pleased that the SleepFuel drink mix does a great job of putting me back to sleep with no morning groggy feeling.
reviews.name: James Y.

reviews.title: Better sleep
reviews.body:
I like the sleep drink mix it helps me sleep, sometimes I use it to get back to sleep when I wake up at night. I have several sleep disorders, including insomnia , parasomnias, middle insomnia. And very mild sleep apnea. Sleepdisorders combined with mental health disorders, MDD, Dysthymia,
GaD,PTSD, all make getting 8 hrs of solid sleep difficult. The Sleep drink mix is a big help in getting bettersleep

reviews.title: Goodnight..sleep tight
reviews.body: I have had issues falling asleep for as long as I can remember everything I tried either had bad side effects or didn't work. Although I was skeptical I tried it and was super surprised. Can't remember when I fell asleep but when I woke up I saw I had slept for 7 hours uninterrupted. Now I'm never without my sleepfuel when I need it.
reviews.name: DAGMAR S.

I’ve tossed and turned many nights. A good friend of mine told me about this company I ordered it and I sleep like a baby every night now not only does it tastes surprisingly good but I get that deep sleep where I go to sleep and wake up in the morning. I don’t feel groggy. I just feel good. I’ve even given it to some of my military veteran buddies and they’re ordering it as well. They even do a military discount so nothing but the high respect to everyone at this company.

Within 15 minutes of taking it, I’m out cold This company not only delivers on quality but also takes care of its own

reviews.title: It's ok so far
reviews.body: I've used SleepFuel for several nights. I go to sleep ok but still wake during the night. However I can drift back to sleep easily. That being said I was using Ambien for over a year and I think it might take some time to readjust. I am not, at present, waking up refreshed. I dont think I need quite as many servings as suggested.
reviews.name: Maryann M.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.body: Absolutely love this product. Most consistent sleep that I can remember. Had sleep issues even as a child. Ambien worked for me as long as I didn't eat and everything was just right but it made me dough headed till late morning almost noon. Started out with recommended 8 sips of the mix and still work up 3 to 4am then went to sleep again after another another sip. Even so much more restful sleep than b4 sleepfuel.
reviews.name: Karen G.

reviews.title: Nice sleep aid
reviews.body: I’m not sure what I was expecting but this stuff worked pretty good. It tastes great and is simple enough to use. I still woke up several times during the night to pee so it doesn’t “keep’ you completely asleep. Can’t really say if I feel any more rested than usual but I’ll keep using it. Maybe I’ll try a few more servings and see how that works…. Worth a try but it’s not a miracle mix
reviews.name: Betty

reviews.title: Still in Testing
reviews.body: I am still having some of the same sleep patterns, but once I do go to sleep, I love not having the drowsy feeling, and I fall right asleep but However initially I am still working on trying to determine the doses to get the proper sleep /.
reviews.name: Joseph B.

reviews.title: Best Natural Sleep
reviews.body: Because I have sleep issues, this is a difficult issue to resolve. It may be hormones. However with that said, Sleep Fuel has been the best natural sleep I have used. Unfortunately, I am still waking up, but it keeps me sleeping longer than if I did not use it.
reviews.name: Nina B.

reviews.title: Essential sleep aid
reviews.body: I often struggle with falling asleep and have tried everything from Zzzquil to melatonin and nothing’s worked consistently or gave me the peace of mind that I wouldn’t grow a tolerance to it. SleepFuel was recommended to me by a friend and at first I was a little hesitant. I’d never heard of a sleep drink mix before, but after reviewing the ingredients, I became intrigued, so I gave it a shot. I’ve been using it on and off as I feel it’s needed for a little over two months now and I can confidently say that it’s changed my nights dramatically. It acts really fast, like you can feel the effects within 15-30 minutes, and it really makes your eyelids feel heavy. In a way, it feels like a dose of melatonin - you want to doze off when it kicks in - but unlike melatonin I don’t feel groggy when I wake up. It’s a legit sleep aid without the negatives of melatonin. One thing I will say is that despite the drowsiness it brings, it can’t settle a runaway mind. Meditating prior to sleep to put an active mind to rest definitely helps in these cases, and SleepFuel helps with the physical side of things. Despite this, I plan to use SleepFuel as an invaluable part of my nightly routine as necessary. Highly recommended!
reviews.name: Kyle

reviews.title: Amazing Post Workout Sleep Aid
reviews.body: Struggling with sleep was my new norm before this product. Work often forces me to visit the gym late in the afternoon, which in turn causes some issues falling asleep at night. This product has been a savior to my nightly routine and allowed me to feel refreshed in the morning, ready to do it all again. Absolutely can not recommend this product enough!
reviews.name: Jake M.

reviews.title: Great even if you're a good sleeper
reviews.body: I have no issues sleeping, but I've really enjoyed using SleepFuel in two particular scenarios: (1) right before bed especially after stressful days when it's a bit harder to wind down; and (2) sometimes I wake up in the middle of the night because I have a newborn (and other times for no reason at all) and it helps me fall back asleep.
reviews.name: Alex M.

reviews.title: Sleep fuels leaves me refreshed and ready to go!
reviews.body: I have always had trouble sleeping but Sleep Fuel really helps me fall asleep, stay asleep, and wake up feeling rested. Shipping was fast and painless. I was impressed by the quality and informativeness of the packaging. Mixing was easy and I was pleasantly surprised by the taste (minty without being overpowering). I began to feel the effects about 15 minutes later and slept like a log! I've been using sleep fuel for about a month and Sleep Fuel is just as effective now as it was the first day I tried it. Huge fan of this product and would highly recommend it to anyone on the fence.
reviews.name: Glenn M.

reviews.title: Best sleep of my life!
reviews.body: This product has changed my nights for the better. I used to toss and turn every night to fall asleep and then wake up several times throughout. The mornings were awful leaving me with little motivation to conquer the day. After using SleepFuel, I fall asleep and stay asleep the entire night. My mental health has improved so much from getting the much needed sleep I was lacking. I wake up so refreshed and ready to take on the day! No more chewing countless melatonin drink mix hoping they’d work this time. Now I simply mix a few servings and drift away to sweet dreams. This product is a game changer. I’ll be a customer for life!
reviews.name: Jessica P.

reviews.title: SleepFuel. PM mix
reviews.body: If anyone knows me they know I am skeptical about trying any products to use in my body. SleepFuel has changed my life! I am able to fall asleep within a few minutes and get the best solid sleep I have ever had. It is easy to use and the fresh mint adds a clean feeling in your mouth at bedtime. I would recommend this product to anyone who is tired of melatonin and feeling groggy in the morning. SleepFuel has me feeling fresh, energized, and ready to tackle a full day of work!
reviews.name: Allyson M.

reviews.title: It does Fuel your sleep!
reviews.body: This does really help get to a deeper more restful sleep, and improves mood/motivation during the following day. It took a few tries to feel the benefits, but after a week + I am definitely enjoying the product!
reviews.name: Trevin P.

reviews.title: SleepFuel

I very much dig the ease of use, and the fact that I don't wake up still feeling the effects or feeling drowzy. reviews.title: Finally found the perfect sleep aid!

This stuff is the real deal and finally do not need to use melatonin!
